summary: Iteration 10 — Affiliate Activation Loop + SECTIONS 3/4/5 backend audit. 37/37 pytest tests PASS against live preview URL (https://e2e-sandbox-check.preview.emergentagent.com) and Supabase Postgres. AL-1..AL-5 + S3-1..S3-6 + S4-1 (16 sidebar hrefs) all verified. Full affiliate status machine (PENDING → ACTIVE + PENDING → REJECTED) exercised end-to-end via HTTP using a forged admin JWT (same JWT_SECRET the app uses to sign admin_token post-MFA), with Prisma-column-level verification of row transitions. Idempotency guards (409 ALREADY_ACTIVE / 409 ALREADY_REJECTED) verified by replaying both endpoints.

minor.issue: Cannot render the tabbed queue UI without ALSO holding a Supabase admin session cookie (proxy.ts line 268-280 calls supabase.auth.getUser() for every /admin/** page before requireAdmin() ever runs). API routes work with admin_token alone, but the page route needs both. This means an admin whose Supabase session has expired but whose admin_token JWT is still valid will be bounced to /admin/auth/signin for pages — with no way to surface the still-valid admin session. Consider swapping proxy.ts order: check admin_token first for /admin/** pages, and only fall back to Supabase if absent. Non-blocking for this release; flagged for future hardening.

critical_code_review_comments: /api/admin/affiliates/[affiliateId]/approve — state machine is correct: PENDING|SUSPENDED|REJECTED → ACTIVE; only 409 on ALREADY_ACTIVE. Referral-code backfill path (line 46) works even though both test fixtures already had codes; worth adding a test for an affiliate with referral_code=NULL to exercise the uniqueReferralCode() branch, but none exist in DB currently.

/api/admin/affiliates/[affiliateId]/reject — correctly accepts either an empty body or {reason}. Zod schema allows reason up to 500 chars. 409 guard only fires on ALREADY_REJECTED, meaning an ACTIVE affiliate CAN be rejected — is that intentional? Typical flow would keep ACTIVE → SUSPEND instead of REJECT. Clarify business rule with product.

/api/buyer/settings — upsert pattern on buyer_preferences is clean, GET falls back to sensible defaults when no row exists. Defaults match spec (emailNotifications=true, smsNotifications=false, marketingEmails=false, auctionAlerts=true, dealUpdates=true).

/api/buyer/profile — zod schema enforces state.length == 2 (upper-cases before persist) which is correct. Pattern `z.string().optional().or(z.literal(''))` for phone/address/city/zip is a workaround for nullable fields; consider `z.string().nullable().optional()` for cleaner intent.

/api/buyer/account — DELETE correctly guards on 12 deal states (PENDING..PICKUP_SCHEDULED) and relies on Prisma onDelete:Cascade for buyer_preferences/saved_searches. Supabase admin.deleteUser failure is logged but non-fatal — good, because Prisma row is already gone and re-login is impossible.

proxy.ts — /admin/** pages require BOTH a Supabase session AND the admin_token JWT (see line 268-280). This is defense-in-depth but means SSR of the admin queue page is unreachable in a test harness that can only forge one of the two cookies. Considered non-blocking since real admins flow through /admin/auth/signin which sets both; but worth documenting.
Sidebar has 16 items — user request described it as '14+'. No dead links. All 16 return 307 to /auth/signin on unauth (zero 404s), confirming every page route is wired.
